description: Lactuca sativa: a rosette of tender leaves.

diseases.name: Downy Mildew
diseases.description: The most important leaf disease of lettuce: pale, angular patches with white spores underneath.
diseases.causes: Spores spread by wind; cool, moist weather with long leaf wetness lets them infect.
symptoms: Pale green to yellow angular patches bounded by veins
White, fluffy spores on the underside
Patches turn brown; outer leaves die
diseases.effect: Spotted leaves must be trimmed; heads may be unsaleable.

steps.title: Remove affected outer leaves
steps.instruction: Pick off affected outer leaves when the plants are dry and take them away.
steps.rationale: Fewer spores are left to spread.

steps.title: Reduce leaf wetness
steps.instruction: Water in the morning; improve airflow.

steps.title: Protective spray
steps.instruction: Spray a registered product for downy mildew on the label's schedule.
steps.rationale: Protects healthy growth; it cannot cure what is already infected.

lifecycle: Spores blow in from infected lettuce.
Cool, moist weather lets them infect.

diseases.name: Lettuce Mosaic
diseases.description: A virus disease that mottles and distorts lettuce and stops heads forming.
diseases.causes: Carried in seed and spread by aphids from infected plants.
symptoms: Light and dark green mottling on the leaves
Leaves distorted and puckered, with clear veins
Plants stunted; heads fail to form
diseases.untreated: Infected seed spreads it to new plantings.

steps.title: Control weeds and aphids
steps.rationale: Hosts for aphids and the virus.
